text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard
text_block_list.text: During my rise to power as the next king, my compatriot, Meisho Doto, suddenly storms the stage! But then, just as we are establishing our leading roles…

text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard
text_block_list.text: I-impossible! The Golden Generation will bow out of the Twinkle Series this year! Meaning… the battlefield shall shift to the Dream Trophy League?!

text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard
text_block_list.text: This news overshadows my achievements. I cannot let this stand!

text_block_list.name: Legendary Bard
text_block_list.text: I call a press conference and make my declaration! I shall amass G1 victories, become king, and put an end to the Golden Generation's reign!
